skills.description_en: Deals physical damage equal to 100% of ATK to one enemy. If Mahmut is in the Front Row, he gains Stoneguard, reducing damage taken by 8% for 1 turn.
Grants Mahmut and the ally with the lowest HP a shield equal to 180% of Mahmut's ATK. For 2 turns, Mahmut redirects 50% of single-target attacks aimed at that ally to himself.
While shielded, Mahmut counters an enemy Basic Attack for 60% of his ATK and gains 5 Focus. Triggers once per turn.

Deals physical damage equal to 220% of ATK to all Front Row enemies, Taunts them for 2 turns, and grants all allies a shield equal to 120% of Mahmut's DEF. The shield still applies if a boss resists Taunt.

provenance.source: Technical feasibility fixture; clone of shipped tutorial kit, not production roster.

skills.description_en: Deals Veil magic damage equal to 100% of ATK to one enemy. Fadyme gains 5 additional Focus if the target is Dreaded.
Deals Veil magic damage equal to 160% of ATK to one enemy and inflicts Dread for 2 turns. Heals the ally with the lowest HP for 100% of Fadyme's ATK.
At the start of her turn, if Fadyme is below 50% HP, all allies gain 8% Veil RES for 1 turn. Triggers up to 2 times per battle.

Deals Veil magic damage equal to 180% of ATK to all enemies and inflicts Dread for 2 turns. Removes 1 debuff from each ally, then heals the allies with the lowest HP for 40% of Fadyme's ATK per debuff removed, up to 3 debuffs.

provenance.source: Technical feasibility fixture; clone of shipped tutorial kit, not production roster.

While shielded, Mahmut counters an enemy Basic Attack for 60% of his ATK and gains 5 Focus. Triggers once per turn.

Deals physical damage equal to 220% of ATK to all Front Row enemies, Taunts them for 2 turns, and grants all allies a shield equal to 120% of Mahmut's DEF. The shield still applies if a boss resists Taunt.

provenance.source: Technical feasibility fixture; clone of shipped tutorial kit, not production roster.

skills.description_en: Deals Veil magic damage equal to 100% of ATK to one enemy. Fadyme gains 5 additional Focus if the target is Dreaded.
Deals Veil magic damage equal to 160% of ATK to one enemy and inflicts Dread for 2 turns. Heals the ally with the lowest HP for 100% of Fadyme's ATK.
At the start of her turn, if Fadyme is below 50% HP, all allies gain 8% Veil RES for 1 turn. Triggers up to 2 times per battle.

Deals Veil magic damage equal to 180% of ATK to all enemies and inflicts Dread for 2 turns. Removes 1 debuff from each ally, then heals the allies with the lowest HP for 40% of Fadyme's ATK per debuff removed, up to 3 debuffs.

provenance.source: Technical feasibility fixture; clone of shipped tutorial kit, not production roster.

limits: The five party proxies clone only Mahmut/Fadyme tutorial kits; they do not represent the actual free/loan roster at any story gate.
Enemy role proxies use existing effect grammar and substitute tutorial art references. Canonical unit/skill/AI/media mapping is still required.
Normalized level 1 and enemy HP +/-20% test tunability and bounded battles, not final chapter difficulty.
No Android, event API, server claim, assets or live content patch tested.
